title: Fourier coefficient of the tribes function
statement: Let $w,s$ be nonnegative integers, and let $T\subseteq[s]\times[w]$, viewed as a subset of the $sw$ coordinates via the standard product indexing. For each block $i\in[s]$, let $T_i\subseteq[w]$ consist of the coordinates of $T$ in that block. The Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the real-valued tribes function is $-\mathbf 1_{T=\varnothing}+2\cdot 2^{-s}\prod_{i\in[s]}\mathbb E_{y\in\{\pm1\}^w}\bigl[(1+\operatorname{AND}_w(y))\chi_{T_i}(y)\bigr]$, where $\operatorname{AND}_w$ takes value $-1$ when all coordinates are $-1$ and $1$ otherwise, and $\chi_{T_i}$ is the corresponding sign monomial.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a subset of the $sw$ coordinates
